message.content:
{
  "summary": "An unusual plant behaviour alarm (PCA.SPE) is active in the pH correction and coagulation area, with AIT-201B (0.54) and AIT-201 (0.42) as top contributors due to probe disagreement. The most likely root cause is a drifting or fouled pH probe misleading the control loop.",
  "likely_causes": [
    "Fouling of the probe by dye, fibre lint or calcium deposits.",
    "Reference junction poisoning, or an ageing electrode past its service life.",
    "Water in the cable gland or a damaged probe cable."
  ],
  "checks": [
    "Take a grab sample from the pH correction tank and measure it with the calibrated hand-held meter.",
    "Compare the hand-held reading with AIT-201, AIT-201B and the discharge pH AIT-501.",
    "Check when each probe was last calibrated (calibration log) and whether it is due.",
    "Inspect the probe for coating and the cable for damage."
  ],
  "handover": "Investigated medium PCA anomaly on AIT-201 and AIT-201B showing probe disagreement in the pH correction tank. Current readings are AIT-201 at 7.20 pH and AIT-201B at 7.59 pH. Operator to perform grab sample checks and inspect probes per SOP-03.",
  "citations": [
    "SOP-03 3.2",
    "SOP-03 3.3",
    "SOP-03 3.4",
    "SOP-02 2.4"
  ]
}
